title: An L¹-bounded linear functional agreeing with ∫·θ on indicators agrees with it on all integrable functions
statement: Let μ be a finite measure on a measurable space α, F : (α → ℝ) → ℝ and C ∈ ℝ such that F(f + g) = F(f) + F(g), F(c f) = c F(f) and |F(f)| ≤ C ∫|f| dμ for all μ-integrable f, g : α → ℝ and all c ∈ ℝ. Let θ : α → ℝ be measurable with |θ(x)| ≤ M for all x ∈ α (for some M ∈ ℝ), and suppose F(1_A) = ∫_A θ dμ for every measurable A ⊆ α, where 1_A is the indicator function of A. Then F(f) = ∫ f θ dμ for every μ-integrable f : α → ℝ.
lean_statement: ∀ {α : Type} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α), IsFiniteMeasure μ → ∀ (F : (α → ℝ) → ℝ) (C : ℝ), (∀ f g : α → ℝ, Integrable f μ → Integrable g μ → F (f + g) = F f + F g) → (∀ (c : ℝ) (f : α → ℝ), Integrable f μ → F (c • f) = c * F f) → (∀ f : α → ℝ, Integrable f μ → |F f| ≤ C * ∫ x, |f x| ∂μ) → ∀ (θ : α → ℝ) (M : ℝ), Measurable θ → (∀ x, |θ x| ≤ M) → (∀ A : Set α, MeasurableSet A → F (A.indicator 1) = ∫ x in A, θ x ∂μ) → ∀ f : α → ℝ, Integrable f μ → F f = ∫ x, f x * θ x ∂μ
